def VTask.ofLeftInverse : {α : Sort u_3} -> {β : Type u_4} -> (f : α → β) -> (f_inv : Nonempty α → β → α) -> (hf : ∀ (h : Nonempty α), Function.LeftInverse (f_inv h) f) -> α ≃ ↑(Set.range f) := by
  intro α β f f_inv hf
  have h_main : α ≃ ↑(Set.range f) := by
    classical
    by_cases hα : Nonempty α
    · -- Case: α is nonempty
      have h_injective : Function.Injective f := by
        -- Prove that f is injective using the left inverse
        have h₁ : Function.LeftInverse (f_inv hα) f := hf hα
        have h₂ : Function.Injective f := by
          intro a₁ a₂ h₃
          have h₄ : f_inv hα (f a₁) = a₁ := h₁ a₁
          have h₅ : f_inv hα (f a₂) = a₂ := h₁ a₂
          have h₆ : f a₁ = f a₂ := h₃
          rw [h₆] at h₄
          exact h₅ h₄
        exact h₂
      -- Use the injective function to construct the equivalence
      have h₂ : α ≃ ↑(Set.range f) := by
        apply Equiv.ofInjective f h_injective
        <;> simp [Set.mem_range]
        <;> aesop
      exact h₂
    · -- Case: α is empty
      have h₃ : IsEmpty α := by
        exact inferInstance
      have h₄ : IsEmpty (Set.range f) := by
        -- Prove that the range of f is empty when α is empty
        have h₅ : ∀ (x : β), x ∉ Set.range f := by
          intro x hx
          rcases hx with ⟨a, rfl⟩
          have h₆ : Nonempty α := ⟨a⟩
          contradiction
        exact ⟨fun x hx => h₅ x hx⟩
      -- Construct the equivalence between empty types
      have h₅ : α ≃ ↑(Set.range f) := by
        apply Equiv.ofEmpty
        <;> simp_all [IsEmpty]
        <;> aesop
      exact h₅
  exact h_main
